P1_carriers.endpoint: storage-gene carrier fraction at step 2000, supply 1 / effect 1, cost 0: (sel p20 - sel stable) - (drift p20 - drift stable)

P2_capacity.endpoint: mean storage capacity at step 6000, supply 16 / effect 4, cost 0: (sel p20 - sel stable) - (drift p20 - drift stable)

P3_competition.endpoint: share of the capacity-8 lineage minus 0.5, pulsed p20, holding cost 0 (win margin, 600 steps, mutation off)

P4_memoryNet.endpoint: median population, memory minus no memory, infection 3 steps / wave interval 6 / decay 0.1, same antigen, fixed genotype

P5_preyRefuge.endpoint: share of runs that go extinct, pulsed, selection on: baseline minus prey refuge 30%

P6_fecundityLock.endpoint: share of runs that go extinct, pulsed, selection on: baseline minus fecundity locked at the founder value
